title: Giveth uses Connection Oriented Cluster Match (COCM) to calculate the quadratic matching distribution to projects. COCM identifies clusters of entities within a network based on their similarities or connections, and is used to mitigate potential sybil attacks and allocate matching funds in a way that rewards unique cooperation.

i.c: Giveth uses Connection Oriented Cluster Match (COCM) to calculate the quadratic matching distribution to projects.
